verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no data-export feature, no bulk export in open formats such as CSV or JSON dumps, and no migration-out path. The only related item is an API endpoint that lists all feedback posts. That is a developer building block a user could script an export from, not the product's own export capability, and it covers only one data type.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
